topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: SIW arrays offer a tradeoff: larger arrays provide higher gain but introduce increased insertion loss due to substrate length and complexity.  This necessitates careful optimization of aperture size, substrate properties, beam steering, and waveguide interactions to achieve optimal radiation efficiency while minimizing insertion losses. Nonlinearities arising from material properties and geometry significantly influence this balance.
